definitions.explanation: The exchange of goods and services between countries or regions.

examples.japanese: {貿易|ぼうえき}⟦{会社|がいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I work at a trading company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧{貿易|ぼうえき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えています→増える：01183_fueru⟧。

⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧{貿易|ぼうえき}⟦{協定|きょうてい}→協定：05320_kyoutei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{両国|りょうこく}→両国：10010_ryoukoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{貿易|ぼうえき}⟦{額|がく}→額：02607_gaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{伸|の}びた→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to the free trade agreement, trade volume between the two countries grew significantly.

notes:
{貿易|ぼうえき} specifically refers to international commerce — the exchange of goods between countries. It does not apply to domestic trade.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {貿易|ぼうえき}{会社|がいしゃ}: trading company
- {国際|こくさい}{貿易|ぼうえき}: international trade
- {自由|じゆう}{貿易|ぼうえき}: free trade
- {貿易|ぼうえき}{赤字|あかじ}: trade deficit
- {貿易|ぼうえき}{黒字|くろじ}: trade surplus
- {貿易|ぼうえき}{摩擦|まさつ}: trade friction

RELATED TERMS:
- {輸出|ゆしゅつ}: export
- {輸入|ゆにゅう}: import
- {商業|しょうぎょう}: commerce (broader, includes domestic)
- {通商|つうしょう}: trade (formal/diplomatic term)
